reason: No proposal addresses hash routing or relative asset paths; shown proposals are about import boundaries and console calls. Code uses hash-based routing (doUpdateHash, '#/' hrefs), relative locale loadPath, and homepage './'; no absolute src/href paths found.
No proposal covers test file placement or naming. Tests are colocated next to sources, but 10 of 30 use .test.ts/.test.tsx rather than .test.js.
No proposal concerns E2E tests. All E2E tests live in test/e2e/ and use Playwright test/expect via ./setup/coverage.js with playwright.config.js.
No proposal about locale registration. Every public/locales/* directory has an entry in src/lib/languages.json, which src/i18n.js imports as its locale list.

No proposal covers i18n namespace organization. en has one namespace file per tab, and tab code mostly uses its own namespace (withTranslation('files'), 'peers', 'status', 'diagnostics'), with a few uses of the shared 'app' namespace.
No proposal about source-locale editing. Sampled non-en locales have no keys absent from en except 3 extra keys in de/files.json, which look like stale keys.
No proposal covers contextBridge usage. The only bridged action, doUpdateIpfsApiAddress, is set via contextBridge.setContext inside ipfs-provider's init(store).
No proposal about this. No react* reactor or selector in src/bundles sets a do* action on the bridge.
No proposal covers bridging redux values. All bridged values (selectIpfs, selectIpfsConnected, selectIsSameOrigin, selectRouteInfo, etc.) are set inside react*ToBridge createSelector reactors.
No proposal about useBridgeContext. The identity context, which bundles consume, exposes it with useBridgeContext('identity', contextValue); the other contexts are not consumed by bundles.

No proposal about context-to-context consumption. LogsProvider depends on identity through useAgentVersionMinimum, which calls useIdentity() directly; no context reads another context through the bridge.
No proposal about this. useBridgeSelector in contexts reads only redux-owned values (selectIpfs, selectIpfsConnected, selectIsNodeInfoOpen), and there is no createContextSelector in contexts.
No proposal about useBridgeSelector. Every useBridgeSelector name in contexts is owned by the not-yet-migrated ipfs-provider or connected bundles.
No proposal about this. The only useBridgeContext call is in identity-context, the source of truth for 'identity'.
No proposal about createContextSelector. peer-locations reads identity with createContextSelector('identity'), and no bundle source uses selectIdentity.
No proposal about context hooks versus connect(). Components that use identity call useIdentity(); no component connects to selectIdentity.
No proposal about useMemo. The identity and ProvideStat context values are memoized. In logs-context the derived values are memoized, but the final contextValue object is not.
